item.title: Mental Game Monday - August 24, 2026
item.description:
This Week's Mental Cue

"Being ready isn't a feeling. It's a decision."

Why It Matters

Your brain will rarely tell you you're ready. Instead, it'll whisper, "You haven't practiced enough," "Everyone else is better," or

Do This On Your Next Shot

Before your next round, when your brain says, "You're not ready," pause and say:"Being ready is a decision. I decide I'm ready. I trust myself to handle whatever happens today." Then step onto the first tee and play from that place.
